name: @intent-wallet/runtime
description: The composition root — the first place the engines are wired to each other into a runnable wallet. It assembles the Intent Engine over REAL sources: the Risk Engine (pure, standalone → wired for real), identity recipient resolution (ContactBook), in-memory holdings, and — where a network vendor isn't available yet — deterministic price/route stubs clearly marked for replacement. One call: natural language → a verified ExecutionPlan (or clarify / rejection). It proposes a plan; it never signs — execution needs the plan plus a device signature downstream.
